title: Similar - 3D Scan Scrap Audit
goal: Analyze one noisy binary STL, isolate the largest connected component, read its attribute-encoded material ID, compute the main-part mass, and also report discarded debris volume and scrap percentage.
skillBenefitRationale: This stays close to the source workflow, so binary STL parsing, connected-component filtering, volume extraction, and attribute lookup remain the core path while adding a richer production-audit output.
